article_title: Behind China's spectacular rise, voices who defied it say they are being drowned out
adaptation_summary: Adapted for level C; emphasis on article-specific comprehension, vocabulary in context, and concise written responses.

tasks.prompt: What is the article's main argument?
options: China's tourism industry has stopped growing
China's economic and political power is making it harder for exiled critics and rights activists to be heard
Uyghur activists have ended all protests in Europe
Western governments have imposed new sanctions at every summit
tasks.correct_answer: China's economic and political power is making it harder for exiled critics and rights activists to be heard
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הטענה המרכזית היא שעוצמתה הכלכלית והמדינית של סין דוחקת לשוליים את קולות המתנגדים ומחלישה את מאבקם.

tasks.prompt: What comparison does Dolkun Isa make between protests in 2018 and today?
options: Crowds grew from 500 to thousands
The location moved from Germany to Xinjiang
Protests changed from human rights to tourism
Thousands once attended, but now activists struggle to gather even 500
tasks.correct_answer: Thousands once attended, but now activists struggle to gather even 500
tasks.explanation_hebrew: דולקון איסא משווה בין אלפים שהשתתפו בעבר לבין הקושי כיום להביא אפילו 500 מפגינים.

tasks.prompt: What does the metaphor “swapping the stick for the carrot” suggest about Beijing's tactics?
options: Replacing punishment alone with incentives such as reunions, money and safety
Ending all contact with overseas communities
Using agricultural exports to gain influence
Allowing every exile to return without conditions
tasks.correct_answer: Replacing punishment alone with incentives such as reunions, money and safety
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המטפורה מתארת מעבר מהפעלת איום בלבד לשימוש בתמריצים שמטרתם להשפיע על גולים ועל המסרים שלהם.

tasks.prompt: How did the Chinese embassy in the UK respond to activists' allegations?
options: It confirmed that every visitor must report on exiles
It announced an end to family visits
It declined to discuss consular services
It rejected spying claims and described family reunions as normal consular work
tasks.correct_answer: It rejected spying claims and described family reunions as normal consular work
tasks.explanation_hebrew: השגרירות דחתה את טענות הריגול והציגה את סיוע הביקורים המשפחתיים כחלק רגיל משירותים קונסולריים.

tasks.prompt: Why can selective family visits weaken trust within diaspora communities?
options: They make travel cheaper for everyone
They may create suspicion that selected visitors are sharing information or promoting official narratives
They guarantee permanent residence in China
They prevent activists from using social media abroad
tasks.correct_answer: They may create suspicion that selected visitors are sharing information or promoting official narratives
tasks.explanation_hebrew: כאשר רק מעטים נבחרים וכמה מהם מתרחקים מפעילים אחרים, נוצרת חשדנות לגבי העברת מידע וקידום נרטיבים רשמיים.

tasks.prompt: What did Mehmut say about his October 2024 family visit?
options: He was openly arrested at the airport
He found conversations fearful, cautious and self-censored
He rebuilt his business immediately
He was unable to meet any family members
tasks.correct_answer: He found conversations fearful, cautious and self-censored
tasks.explanation_hebrew: מהמוט תיאר מפגשים שטחיים ושיחות שבהן אנשים חששו ונזהרו בדבריהם, גם בלי פיקוח גלוי.

tasks.prompt: Identify two ways China's global rise has changed the environment in which activists operate.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לזהות שתי השפעות מבוססות: משקל כלכלי ועוצמה רכה שמעצבים מדיניות חוץ, ועלות גבוהה יותר לביקורת, לצד ירידת זכויות האדם בסדר העדיפויות.
expected_points: Chinese products, technology and cultural exports have expanded its economic and soft-power reach.
Governments weigh economic interests and geopolitical calculations when responding to rights concerns.
The cost of confronting or condemning Beijing has increased.
Some Western governments have become more inward-looking and give human rights lower priority.

tasks.prompt: Explain how family reunions can function both as genuine contact and as a source of pressure, according to the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג את שתי הפרספקטיבות: עמדת השגרירות שמדובר בשירות רגיל ואפשרות למפגש, מול טענות הפעילים על תנאים, איסוף מידע, קידום מסרים ופחד למשפחות.
expected_points: The embassy says reunions are normal consular services and that contact with relatives is protected.
Exiles may gain rare opportunities to see family after years of separation.
Activists allege that some invitations are tied to requests for information or pro-party messaging.
Selective eligibility and concern for relatives can encourage silence and self-censorship.

tasks.prompt: Write 4–5 sentences analysing how the article balances claims made by activists with Beijing's response.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שהכתבה מביאה עדויות של פעילים ודוגמאות אישיות, מייחסת להן את הטענות, מציגה את הכחשת השגרירות ואת הסברה לשירותים הקונסולריים, ומותירה לקורא להבחין בין גרסאות.
expected_points: The article attributes allegations about pressure and information-gathering to named activists and interviewees.
It gives concrete examples, including reported invitations and changes in behaviour after visits.
It includes the Chinese embassy's denial of spying claims.
It presents the embassy's description of reunions as normal consular services.
The contrast distinguishes reported experiences from the official position.

tasks.prompt: Summarise in 5–6 sentences how economic power, family ties and changing tactics affect exiled critics of China.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לשלב את עוצמתה הכלכלית והרכה של סין, ירידת תשומת הלב הבינלאומית, שימוש בביקורי משפחות ותמריצים, החשדנות בתוך הקהילות, תגובת בייג׳ינג וההתמדה של הפעילים.
expected_points: China's economic reach and soft power make foreign governments more cautious about criticism.
Activists report smaller protests and less international attention than in 2018.
Some exiles say offers of reunions, money or safety are linked to information or favourable messaging.
Selective visits and fear for relatives can produce silence, self-censorship and distrust.
Beijing rejects spying allegations and calls reunions normal consular work.
Despite pressure, activists such as Karma Rinchen say their communities must remain persistent.
